housing.summary: Numbeo's city ranking lists a 1-bedroom city-centre rent of USD 3,811.67 per month. California Civil Code section 1950.5 caps most residential security deposits at one month's rent, with a qualifying small-landlord exception up to two months. Zillow provides a San Francisco rentals portal. Deposit source: https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=1950.5. Portal source: https://www.zillow.com/san-francisco-ca/rentals/

banking.summary: Bank of America's official international-professional page says eligible non-U.S. citizens opening in person need proof of foreign and U.S. addresses, one primary and one secondary ID, and a foreign tax identification number; a U.S. TIN or ITIN is needed only if one has been issued.
required_docs: Proof of home or permanent residence address
One primary photo ID, such as a foreign passport
One secondary ID, such as a foreign driver's license or major debit or credit card
Foreign tax identification number; U.S. TIN or ITIN if already issued

schools.summary: The International School of San Francisco offers French bilingual immersion, the International Baccalaureate, and French Baccalaureate pathways. The California Association of Independent Schools member directory lists the school. Directory source: https://www.caisca.org/schools

legal_admin.summary: Most noncitizens in the United States must report an address change to USCIS within 10 days of moving; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt. The change can be submitted through a USCIS online account or by mailing Form AR-11.
legal_admin.registration_step: Report a change of U.S. address to USCIS within 10 days of moving through a USCIS online account or Form AR-11, unless an exemption or special procedure applies.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who needs a U.S. taxpayer identification number but is not eligible for an SSN can apply to the IRS for an ITIN by completing Form W-7, generally attaching a federal income-tax return, and providing supporting documents proving foreign status and identity.

transport.summary: SFMTA's Muni-only adult monthly pass provides unlimited Muni rides, including cable cars, for USD 86. Transit source: https://www.sfmta.com/fares/monthly-adult-ages-19-64 California DMV requires holders of a foreign driver license to follow the standard original-license application process and also pass a driving test. Driving source: https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/driver-licenses-identification-cards/driver-licenses-dl/ Medi-Cal is California's public Medicaid program for eligible residents; applications can be made online, by phone, by mail, or at a county office. Healthcare source: https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/services/medi-cal/pages/applyformedi-cal.aspx
transport.driving_licence_exchange: There is no simple foreign-license exchange: follow California's standard original driver-license application process and pass a driving test.
transport.healthcare_registration: If eligible, apply for Medi-Cal online, by phone, by mail, or through a county office.
